attempted_claim: For every integer n >= 1, construct an explicit, non-random hyperbolic group G_n such that G_n satisfies Property (FW_n) (every action on an n-dimensional CAT(0) cube complex has a global fixed point) but G_n acts properly and cocompactly on a CAT(0) cube complex of cubical dimension n+1, ideally as a cubical small-cancellation quotient of a compact special (cubical hierarchically hyperbolic) group.
decisive_failure: The investigation stopped at a documented open-problem barrier rather than a construction: the missing explicit FW_n-preserving hyperbolic lift with exact cubical-dimension n+1 control (Genevois Problem 4.4, open as of December 2025) could not be proved in this pass, so no group family, presentation, or dimension certificate is offered.
